_notes: Aspen Wilderness / Weeping Ice boss and named-rare loot (2026-10-27). ONE item drops per kill from the pool. item_level = creature level + 3; real loot formulas (tools/build_durotar_content.make). Checked by tools/qa_aspen_content.py.

The Last Kodo.name: Horn of the Last Herd
The Last Kodo.flavor_text: Hafted by somebody who did not know what it was and could tell it mattered.

The Last Kodo.name: Hide of the Last Herd
The Last Kodo.flavor_text: Still smells of red dust, three winters on.

The Last Kodo.name: Seam-Walker's Girdle
The Last Kodo.flavor_text: He crossed the line going the wrong way and never worked out how to cross back.

The Last Kodo.name: Dustcaught Wraps
The Last Kodo.flavor_text: Shake them out and the Barrens comes off in your palm.

Goldcrown.name: Goldcrown's Antler Stave
Goldcrown.flavor_text: Shed, found, and worth more than the stag ever was.

Goldcrown.name: Gilded Canopy Mantle
Goldcrown.flavor_text: The light comes through these trees sideways, and gold, and only in the afternoon.

Goldcrown.name: Pale Bark Leggings
Goldcrown.flavor_text: Aspen bark takes a scar and keeps it. So do these.

Goldcrown.name: Stand-Watcher's Sabatons
Goldcrown.flavor_text: You can see forty yards in a stand like that and hear four hundred.

Bristlehide the Wintered.name: Bristlehide's Cleaver
Bristlehide the Wintered.flavor_text: Quilboar iron, re-ground for wood instead of flesh. It does both.

Bristlehide the Wintered.name: Wintered Tusk Pauldrons
Bristlehide the Wintered.flavor_text: She grew the tusks in a desert and broke them on a mountain.

Bristlehide the Wintered.name: Frost-Bitten Bracers
Bristlehide the Wintered.flavor_text: The hide under them never did grow back right.

Bristlehide the Wintered.name: Thornspeaker's Kilt
Bristlehide the Wintered.flavor_text: They are praying to something that has never once answered up here.

Rimehowl.name: Rimehowl's Frozen Maul
Rimehowl.flavor_text: He did not make it and he did not need to. Something else brought it across.

Rimehowl.name: Pelt of the Last Winter
Rimehowl.flavor_text: Grown for a cold that does not exist on this continent.

Rimehowl.name: Glacier-Born Helm
Rimehowl.flavor_text: Ice this old is blue, and blue all the way through.

Rimehowl.name: Meltwater Greaves
Rimehowl.flavor_text: Everything down here is wet and none of it used to be.

Snowmaw.name: Snowmaw's Claw
Snowmaw.flavor_text: She denned here when it was only a cave, and she was here first.

Snowmaw.name: Denmother's Cloak
Snowmaw.flavor_text: Warm enough for a mountain she was not born on.

Snowmaw.name: Meltwater Waders
Snowmaw.flavor_text: The cistern is ankle-deep and it is never going to drain.

Snowmaw.name: Bear-Tooth Pendant
Snowmaw.flavor_text: One tooth, drilled through, on a cord somebody else tied.

The Last Drift.name: Icemelt Focus
The Last Drift.flavor_text: It weeps steadily and has not got any smaller. Nobody can say why.

The Last Drift.name: Drift-Watcher's Cowl
The Last Drift.flavor_text: He sits where the melt has not reached and watches it come.

The Last Drift.name: Old Ice Vambraces
The Last Drift.flavor_text: Rime that has set hard enough to take a blow.

The Last Drift.name: Thawstone
The Last Drift.flavor_text: Cold in the hand all day, and no colder by evening.
